verdict.rationale: Adyen documents the mechanics of accepting online card payments: a single /sessions Checkout API call, web and mobile SDKs, payment links, a test environment, and no setup fee. Nothing in the evidence supports going live within a day of signing up. Community reports point the other way: small clients under the million are refused, minimum processing volumes and monthly invoices apply, large reserves are required for subscription models, and one team spent hundreds of hours integrating. Missing for 10: documented self-serve signup and fast live-account activation, evidence that early-stage founders are accepted, and hands-on evidence of a same-day go-live.
